# Dra. Erika Caballero | Medicina Estética Medellín

## About
Dra. Erika Caballero is a medical aesthetic specialist based in Medellín, Colombia. She specializes in facial harmonization, anti-aging treatments, and premium aesthetic procedures.

## Services
- Facial Harmonization
- Botox (Toxin Botulinica)
- Dermal Fillers (Acid Hialurónico)
- Non-surgical Rhinoplasty
- Advanced Skin Care
